message.content: {"caption":"Three line charts compare Base, PPO, and GRPO scores across three Qwen-2.5 model sizes.","description":"Three side-by-side line charts show scores for Qwen-2.5-3B, Qwen-2.5-7B, and Qwen-2.5-14B. Each chart uses connected circular markers for Base (blue), PPO (orange), and GRPO (green), identified by legends inside the plots. The left chart plots F1 Score, the middle chart B1 Score, and the right chart J Score. There are no arrows. In F1 and B1, all three series rise with model size; PPO and GRPO are above Base at every size, and PPO and GRPO draw closer at the largest size. In J, Base rises from 3B to 7B then falls at 14B, while PPO and GRPO rise throughout; PPO finishes highest, and both tuned series exceed Base at each size.
